## Read data

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| output: false

variables <- read.csv("Worksheets/curated_variables.csv", header = T, check.names=FALSE, na.strings=c("","NA","N/A"))
variable_details <- read.csv("Worksheets/curated_variable_details.csv", header = T, check.names=FALSE, na.strings=c("","NA","N/A"))

data <- read.csv(paste0(dirname(getwd()), "/1. Curate the data/Curated data/Ottawa_trial_combine_curated_scores.csv"), 
                 header = T, check.names=FALSE, na.strings=c("",".","NA", "N/A"))
data <- data[,variables$Short.name]
```

## make the categorical variables as factor and update the labels if applicable

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

flag_print <- F
for (var in unique(variable_details$Short.name)) {
  if (flag_print) {
    print("-------------")
    print(table(data[var], useNA = "ifany"))
  }
  label_vec <- as.vector(unlist(variable_details %>% filter(Short.name==var) %>% select(OptionLabel)))
  label_vec <- label_vec[!is.na(label_vec)]
  
  label_vec_2 <- as.vector(unlist(variable_details %>% filter(Short.name==var) %>% select(ShortLabel)))
  label_vec_2 <- label_vec_2[!is.na(label_vec_2)]
  
  if (!all(label_vec==label_vec_2)) # need to update labels
  {
    vec <- unlist(data[var])
    for (i in seq_len(length(label_vec))){
      vec[which(vec == label_vec[i])] <- label_vec_2[i]
    }
    data[var] <- vec
  }
  
  # make it factor with proper levels
  data[names(data)[which(names(data) == var)]] <- 
    lapply(data[names(data)[which(names(data) == var)]], factor, levels = label_vec_2)
  if (flag_print) {
    print(table(data[var], useNA = "ifany"))
    print(lapply(data[names(data)[which(names(data) == var)]], levels))
  }
}

# drop levels since some options in the variable detail sheet were never chosen
data <- data %>% droplevels()

levels(data$group) <- c("HC", "PD", "OND")
```

## Table 1: summary of the cohort

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

# For the cohort who have complete PREDIGT 1.0 Questionnaire - original PREDIGT Score
df <- data
table(df$diagnosis, useNA = "ifany")

var_vec <- variables$Short.name[which(variables$Table1 == 1)]
name_vec <- variables$Long.name[which(variables$Table1 == 1)]

df_O_tbl1 <- df %>%
  select(group, group2,all_of(var_vec))
names(df_O_tbl1)[c(3:ncol(df_O_tbl1))] <- name_vec

df_O_tbl1 %>% select(-group2) %>% 
  tbl_summary(by = group,
              missing = "no") %>%
  add_p() %>%
  add_q() %>%
  modify_header(label = "**Variable**") %>% # update the column header
  modify_caption("Table 1. Patient Characteristics in Ottawa Trial: PREDIGT1.0 Questionnaire") %>%
  bold_labels() %>% 
  bold_p(t = 0.05) 
# %>% as_flex_table() 
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
```

```{r}
# OR
var_vec <- variables$Short.name[which(variables$OR == 1)]

# PREDIGT1.0
df <- data
df1 <- df %>% filter(group %in% c("HC", "PD")) %>% droplevels() %>% 
  mutate(group_num = ifelse(group == "HC", 0, 1))                         # PD vs HC 
df2 <- df %>% filter(group %in% c("OND", "PD")) %>% droplevels() %>% 
  mutate(group_num = ifelse(group == "OND", 0, 1))                        # PD vs OND
df3 <- df %>% 
  mutate(group_num = ifelse(group == "PD", 1, 0))                     # PD vs Other (HC + OND)

res <- data.frame(variable = var_vec)
res$nHC   <- rep(NA, nrow(res))
res$nHC_1 <- rep(NA, nrow(res))
res$nHC_p <- rep(NA, nrow(res))
res$nPD   <- rep(NA, nrow(res))
res$nPD_1 <- rep(NA, nrow(res))
res$nPD_p <- rep(NA, nrow(res))
res$nOND   <- rep(NA, nrow(res))
res$nOND_1 <- rep(NA, nrow(res))
res$nOND_p <- rep(NA, nrow(res))
res$or_1    <- rep(NA, nrow(res))
res$or_2    <- rep(NA, nrow(res))
res$or_3    <- rep(NA, nrow(res))

check <- F
for (i in 1:length(var_vec)) {
  dfi <- df %>% select(group, all_of(var_vec[i]))
  names(dfi)[2] <- "var"
  tab1 <- table(dfi$group)
  tab2 <- table(dfi)
  if (check) print(tab2)
  
  res$nHC[i] <- tab1[1]
  res$nHC_1[i] <- tab2[1,2]
  res$nHC_p[i] <- paste0(res$nHC_1[i], " (", round(res$nHC_1[i]/res$nHC[i]*100, 1), "%)")
  
  res$nPD[i] <- tab1[2]
  res$nPD_1[i] <- tab2[2,2]
  res$nPD_p[i] <- paste0(res$nPD_1[i], " (", round(res$nPD_1[i]/res$nPD[i]*100, 1), "%)")
  
  res$nOND[i] <- tab1[3]
  res$nOND_1[i] <- tab2[3,2]
  res$nOND_p[i] <- paste0(res$nOND_1[i], " (", round(res$nOND_1[i]/res$nOND[i]*100, 1), "%)")
  
  if (res$nPD_1[i] > 0) {
    f <- as.formula(paste0("group_num ~ age + sex + ", var_vec[i]))
    if (res$nHC_1[i] > 0) {
      m1 <- glm(f, df1, family = binomial)
      res$or_1[i] <- paste0(round(exp(coef(m1)[4]), 2), " (", round(exp(confint(m1)[4,1]),2), "-", round(exp(confint(m1)[4,2]),2), ")")
    }
    if (res$nOND_1[i] > 0) {
      m1 <- glm(f, df2, family = binomial)
      res$or_2[i] <- paste0(round(exp(coef(m1)[4]), 2), " (", round(exp(confint(m1)[4,1]),2), "-", round(exp(confint(m1)[4,2]),2), ")")
    }
    m1 <- glm(f, df3, family = binomial)
    res$or_3[i] <- paste0(round(exp(coef(m1)[4]), 2), " (", round(exp(confint(m1)[4,1]),2), "-", round(exp(confint(m1)[4,2]),2), ")")
  }
}
res_or <- res
res_or[, c("variable", "nHC_p", "nPD_p", "nOND_p", "or_1", "or_2", "or_3")]
```

## Additional info for Supplementary Table 1: Continuous variables

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

# PREDIGT1.0
df <- data
var_vec <- variables$Short.name[which(variables$Con_summary_table == 1)]
name_vec <- variables$Long.name[which(variables$Con_summary_table == 1)]

df_O_tbl1 <- df %>%
  select(group, group2, sex, all_of(var_vec))
names(df_O_tbl1)[c(4:ncol(df_O_tbl1))] <- name_vec

df_O_tbl1 %>% select(-c(group2, sex)) %>% 
  tbl_summary(by = group,
              missing = "no",
              type = list("NeuroScent score" ~ "continuous")) %>%
  add_p() %>%
  add_q() %>%
  modify_header(label = "**Variable**") %>% # update the column header
  modify_caption("Table 3. Continuous variables in Ottawa Trial: PREDIGT1.0 Questionnaire") %>%
  bold_labels() %>% 
  bold_p(t = 0.05)
```
